response.text:
I can do that — I just need a couple quick details before I reschedule:

1. Which Friday — this coming Friday or a specific date (please give the date)?  
2. By “my time” which timezone do you mean (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, etc.)?  
3. Do you want to change only that one occurrence or the whole recurring series? (reply “one” or “series”)  
4. Confirm the new time is 8:00 AM in your time zone. Do you want me to include a short note to attendees explaining the change?

Optional: I can use this message when I update the event (edit or paste as-is). Approve or edit it:
“Hi all — current partner sync at 4:00 PM (my time) is difficult for the London team. I’m moving this meeting to 8:00 AM [your timezone] on [date]. Please let me know if this causes a conflict. Thanks.”

Reply with the four items above (date or “this Friday”, your timezone, one/series, and yes/no for the note) and I’ll reschedule it.
